title: A documentation synchronization change leaves contradictory unchanged sibling documents

scenario.observed_change: A documentation synchronization pull request updates one architecture document and adds a focused guard for that document, while unchanged sibling architecture documents in the same relevant context retain obsolete statements that contradict the current implementation and the updated document.
controlled_inputs: the changed architecture document and its focused documentation guard
unchanged sibling architecture documents relevant to the same synchronization goal
the current executable implementation and validator behavior those documents describe
mutable_state: the reader-visible architecture contract distributed across the relevant documents
the effective scope of regression guards for documentation drift
authority_boundaries: the changed document versus unchanged sibling normative and consumer context
executable behavior authority versus documentation that communicates that behavior
operation_model: update one architecture document to match current executable behavior
run a focused documentation guard that covers the changed document
leave relevant sibling architecture documents unchanged
readers can still encounter stale contradictory contract statements outside the diff

required_invariants.requirement: A reviewer must inspect the changed material together with relevant unchanged normative and consumer context needed to establish whether the stated synchronization goal is actually complete.

must_investigate: the changed document, relevant unchanged sibling documents, and the executable behavior they collectively describe
whether the regression guard covers the full documentation context required by the synchronization goal
whether any relevant unchanged document retains wording that contradicts the synchronized current behavior
must_identify: the documentation synchronization is incomplete because relevant unchanged sibling documents retain stale contradictory semantics
must_not_claim: that the synchronization goal is complete merely because the changed document matches the implementation and its focused test passes
a clean review without inspecting relevant unchanged sibling context needed to establish the stated documentation goal

provenance.note: The historical exact-head review expanded beyond the changed document and focused guard to relevant unchanged sibling architecture documents and found stale contradictory passages. This case isolates the changed-files-only context failure mechanism rather than the reviewer or provider identity.
